learning_modes.document_memory: RAG: extracted document text is indexed locally and retrieved at answer time; model weights do not change.
learning_modes.weight_adaptation: SFT/LoRA: approved, rights-cleared examples are used in a deliberate training run; resulting adapters are not loaded by the PWA until merged, exported and quantized to ONNX.

warnings: SUN is a customised application identity built on an Apache-2.0 foundation checkpoint, not a from-scratch LLM.
The 0.6B parameter model is compact and may produce factual or coding errors.
Initial model download is hundreds of megabytes and may exceed low-end phone storage or memory.
The LoRA training pipeline has not been executed in this repository.
